_note: Curated SEED merge map. For a source role, each growth DIRECTION (ic_tech = deeper hands-on/technical IC; ic_nontech = analyst/product/strategy IC; people = management) names a partner role to merge with, the emergent merged role title, and a one-line rationale. The engine synthesizes the merged role's skill vector from the residual-human skills of both roles plus AI-orchestration 'glue' skills. Illustrative only. 'partner' must be a role id in roles.json. If a source role is absent here, the engine falls back to a family-based partner per direction.
